_prompt:
You are matching code-review findings against a known bug. Reply with ONLY a JSON object.

KNOWN BUG: When a child of the dialog uses autoFocus, focus does not return to the element that opened the dialog after it closes.

Rules:
- Answer "yes" only if the text describes THIS specific bug: the same faulty behaviour in the same situation. A finding about a nearby but different behaviour (another header, another edge case, a different race) is "no".
- A finding that says the behaviour was checked and PASSED, or that the code handles it correctly, is "no".
- Wording does not matter; the behaviour does.

=== REVIEW FINDINGS ===
- [blocking] Nested dialogs: one Escape closes both. Both Dialogs listen for Escape on `document`. `P1`: `expected "spy" to be called +0 times, but got 1 times` (outer `onOpenChange` fired). Also seen in `Q3`, where the outer dialog unmounts on the inner Escape.
- [blocking] `autoFocus` child breaks focus return (D5). The opener is read with `document.activeElement` in the effect, after the child's autoFocus has already moved focus into the dialog. `Q2`: open from button, Escape, `expected <body><button></button>` to have focus; focus lands on body. `Q2b`: unmount while open with an autoFocus input restores to body, not the opener.
- [blocking] Focus escapes the dialog via `tabindex=-1` content (D3/D6). `trapTab` only wraps when the active element is first or last in the focusable list. `P8`/`Q1`: dialog with a button and `<span tabIndex={-1}>`, focus on the span, Tab → `activeElement` is `body`, not inside the dialog.
- [blocking, SSR scope] `renderToString` of `Tabs defaultValue="c"` produces no `aria-selected="true"` on any tab, because the selection is computed in a layout effect. `P11`: `expected '<div>…' to match /aria-selected="true"/`. Fix or state the client-only limitation in the README.
- [minor] README line 66–67 says a `visibility: visible` child under a hidden parent is focusable. The code matches, but the "Visibility is inherited, so…" wording reads as a contradiction. Reworded sentence suggested.
- [minor] Combobox cannot clear the selection from the UI (`null` is never emitted). The README documents this and parent-driven `value={null}` works, but it's worth confirming this is intended.
- [minor] `FEATURE_FLOW.md` is in FILES but does not exist, and the diff does not touch it.
- [minor] Dialog backdrop has no styling, so in a real browser it is zero-sized and the backdrop-click close is effectively unreachable without consumer CSS. Not reproduced in jsdom.
